method: Inspect all four geographic diagrams at normal and enlarged display sizes; use central axes and repeated hatching rather than curved labels.

icons.reference: Central equator is level; preserve the curved parallels and arched title.
Central meridian is upright; curved side meridians are intentional.
Equator and central polar axis are level and upright; labels follow the curved parallels.
Vertical hatching is upright; latitude bands and lettering are intentionally curved.
